There are always many people at the temple fair. The weather was windy that day. The family dinner table is one of the best places in the city. For example, the train crosses the borders of three countries before lunch.
Ben is going to travel to Tokyo in May. Last Saturday, Ben and Jack went to the family dinner table. Ben wrote about the day in the diary. Most teenagers love sleeping late.

Ben thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the family dinner table by bike. Jack is interested in reading. The city improved public transportation with new buses.
Jack's birthday is in May. Ben hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Ben's favorite animal is the panda.
